listing.name: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe (Racing-8-DX-Recomp)
listing.summary: An experimental Mario Kart 8 Deluxe project documenting strict ahead-of-time translation with SUYU_NO_JIT=ON and native Vulkan. Its emulator ancestry alone does not prove runtime CPU JIT; strict coverage has not been exercised. The project claims 60 FPS races and four-player play on AMD. DLSS compiles but has not been tested on NVIDIA; game rates above 60 FPS are planned. Tag v0.1.0 contains no package files. The source launcher generates a personal AppImage locally; no downloadable AppImage is established. Linux is the documented workflow with exact CPU support unconfirmed; Windows is planned and Android is in development. Use your own base game and 3.0.4 update, optional owned DLC, keys and firmware. Generated rtld/main/subsdk modules remain private; exact region/build hashes are unconfirmed. Portcove offers no setup or launch integration and has not tested gameplay.
